item.title: Educational Processor PCB Board
item.description:
An educational PCB designed for the AGH Logic Unit research group that demonstrates fundamental processor architecture and real-time data flow using interactive hardware visualization.

Project Overview

The board allows physical tracing of signals between memory, registers, and the ALU. All operations are controlled manually via switches and push-buttons, with logic states visualized in real time across different functional blocks using LEDs.

Key Functional Blocks

  • Register File: Implemented as a 4x4 LED matrix representing four 4-bit registers, allowing direct observation of data distribution and manual pattern creation.
  • ALU (Arithmetic Logic Unit): Asynchronous unit performing bitwise operations (AND, OR) on data fetched from selected source registers.
  • Instruction & Data Memory: LED indicators displaying current input configurations, opcodes, and final execution results.
  • Manual Control Interface: Dedicated switches for data line inputs (DATA [3..0]), register selection (R SET, REG 0, REG 1), write triggers (WE), and asynchronous system reset (RST).
  • Role: Schematic & PCB Layout Design
  • Organization: AGH Logic Unit Student Research Group

item.title: Proffieboard V2 Lightsaber
item.description:
A high-durability, combat-ready lightsaber replica built on the Proffieboard V2 soundboard, featuring custom audio fonts and real-time LED illumination.

Project Overview

Designed and assembled for full-contact dueling, this replica integrates high-power LED drivers, dynamic motion control, and responsive audio playback within a custom machined metal hilt.

Key Specifications

  • Core Controller: Proffieboard V2 running open-source motion and sound synthesis logic.
  • Audio & Visuals: SmoothSwing motion tracking, custom sound fonts, and high-brightness LED illumination.
  • Build Quality: Machined metal hilt with reinforced chassis for combat readiness.
  • Role: System Integration, Electronics Assembly & Configuration

item.title: Analog Guitar Multi-FX
item.description:
A modular analog guitar multi-effect integrating an entire signal chain.

Project Overview

This project focuses on building a versatile, modular analog signal processor for electric guitar.

  • Multifx v1: A simplified prototype with hand-etched PCBs serving as the testing foundation for modular routing and relay logic.
  • Multifx v2 (In Progress): An upgraded modular architecture featuring commercially fabricated PCB boards and refined signal path switching.

Key Features

  • Relay-Controlled Routing: True-bypass switching system for dynamic effect chain configuration.
  • Custom Analog Circuits: Integrated distortion and modulation stages on dedicated circuit boards.
  • Role: Analog Circuit & PCB Design, Enclosure Assembly
  • Demo Video: Watch on YouTube

item.title: Arduino-Based Sim Racing Pedals
item.description:
A custom 3D-printed USB sim racing pedal set combining Arduino microcontroller logic.

System Architecture

  • Interface: Emulates a USB Human Interface Device (HID) for game compatibility.
  • Control: Arduino microcontroller processing input signal.
  • Mechanical Structure: Custom 3D-printed pedal arms and mounting framework.

item.title: Single-Channel 20W Solid-State Guitar Amplifier
item.description:
A compact 20W single-channel solid-state guitar amplifier engineered for clean audio amplification and active tone shaping.

Project Overview

A standalone analog audio amplifier featuring a preamplifier and active EQ controls, housed in a custom wooden enclosure.

Key Features

  • Power Output: 20W solid-state power amplifier block.
  • Control Interface: Dedicated Volume, Treble, Bass, and Gain controls.
  • Role: Circuit Design, Assembly & Enclosure Wiring
